issues: React dev-warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning. Caused by framework instrumentation wrapping option's dynamic {o.role} text in a span with style=display:contents. Not a runtime bug (dropdown works) but a noisy hydration warning.

action_items: Optional: silence the <span> child of <option> hydration warning by keeping option children as raw strings (no wrappers). Purely cosmetic dev-time warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ResetPassword.js allows submission with token in URL that could be arbitrarily long; consider a minimum length check to short-circuit obvious garbage before the API call (small UX polish).

ForgotPassword.js explicitly exposes the reset token in the response body (dev/demo convenience). Fine for this MVP but is worth removing before real production so the endpoint stops leaking a valid password reset token.

Onboarding.onResume() silently drops the toast context when the parse succeeds but returns empty arrays — user could think 'imported' even if nothing was extracted. Consider counting extracted items in the toast: 'Imported N skills'.
server.py /api/resume/parse loads pypdf/python-docx inside the request handler; move imports to module level to fail fast at startup and avoid per-request import cost.

server.py /api/auth/google always upserts a new user with password_hash=None. If a password user already exists with the same email, this branch reuses that user (good). But it does not update auth_provider - could be worth setting a linked_providers list.
Interview.js selectedOpp.required_skills.map assumes required_skills is present; if backend ever returns opportunities without that key it will crash. Add optional chaining.
